title: French-Style Roast Beef
description: A classic French dish featuring a slow-cooked roast beef with a peppery crust. Perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Rub the roast all over with peppercorns.
Season the roast with festive salt.
Heat argentinian olive oil in a large skillet over high heat.
Sear the roast on all sides until browned, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the roast to a roasting pan and roast in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
Reduce oven temperature to 160°C (325°F) and continue roasting for another 1.5 hours.
Baste the roast with gooey butter every 30 minutes during the last hour of cooking.
Let the roast rest for 15 minutes before slicing and serving.
